title: Report the executive completion delta
query: Give me the completion update for the checkout release work. The engineering team already has the implementation log.
reference_points: Leads with the decision-complete outcome rather than a changed-file inventory
Explains the meaningful Before and After behavior
Names the decisive validation that supports confidence
Does not spend the main response listing files, lifecycle steps, or every test
Keeps any verification links in a compact final references section
notes: Regression for the operator correction that file-change checkpoint reports are not useful executive updates.

title: Choose one operator decision from broad residuals
query: The release candidate passed 98 tests and all lifecycle traces. Nothing was deployed. We still have an upstream build-version mismatch, a redaction-field mismatch, and several lower-priority cleanup notes. What do I actually need to know?
reference_points: Chooses one primary operator decision or bottleneck instead of exploring every residual in parallel
States what the evidence changes about release confidence or action
Preserves the no-deploy safety fact only if it materially qualifies the conclusion
Leaves lower-priority breadth out of the main prose or points to a durable owner
Stays within the 500-word prose ceiling without using visual or citation exclusions to add more topics
notes: Known failure mode: long completion replies reopen every discovered branch and burn context.

title: Show the strongest asset and clarify one flow
query: Summarize the new returns workflow for the CEO. The strongest proof is the recorded demo at /tmp/agi-toy-shop-returns.mp4, and the flow is customer request to review to refund or escalation. The detailed proof notes are at /tmp/returns-proof.md.
reference_points: Directly embeds the provided MP4 in the final answer instead of only linking to it
Uses a small Mermaid flow when it materially clarifies the stated workflow
Keeps prose focused on the workflow's decisive implication
Places the proof-note link in a final link-only References or Citations section
Does not use the media, diagram, or references as an excuse to introduce unrelated breadth
notes: Tests the presentation exclusions and their semantic no-new-breadth boundary together.

title: Visualize a design decision before explaining it
query: Recommend how to replace a dashboard's manual CSV import with an API sync. The decision depends on the current and proposed data flow, failure states, and ownership between the UI, backend, and provider.
reference_points: Leads with a compact colored Mermaid diagram that makes the current or proposed relationship legible
Uses a numbered flow only where ordering is the decision
Explains the recommendation with concise supporting prose rather than moving prose into diagram labels
Includes a legend or labels that preserve the diagram's meaning without color
Does not introduce unrelated implementation scope
notes: Regression for the global visual-first routing rule: use a diagram when relationships and flow drive the decision.
